title: Deputy Manager - Engineering
description:
Ammann, a global leader in construction equipment with a rich heritage since 1869, offers a dynamic work environment for passionate individuals. As a subsidiary of Ammann BauAusrüstung AG (ABA) since 2013, Ammann India leverages its Swiss heritage and expertise to empower the Indian construction industry.
  
  
We are the
**largest and most trusted manufacturer of Road Construction Equipment in India**
, boasting a state-of-the-art manufacturing facility in Mehsana, Gujarat, and a robust network of 17 Sales & Service Offices nationwide.
  
  
**Why Ammann India?**
**Innovation & Legacy:**
Be part of a company with a pioneering spirit and a commitment to shaping the future of construction.
  
  
**Growth & Opportunity:**
Join a rapidly growing organization with a strong workforce of over 1800 employees (including contract staff) and a turnover exceeding INR 900 crore.
  
  
**Supportive Environment:**
We believe in fostering a collaborative and rewarding work culture that empowers our employees to excel.
  
  
**Ready to build your career with a leader in construction?**
**Visit our website (**
**www.ammann.com**
**) to explore exciting career opportunities.**
**Join us in building a more sustainable future for India's infrastructure.**
**The Position**
Position Title Project Manager – Machine Division
  
  
Position Level Dy Manager / Manager
  
  
Location Ditasan, Mehsana, Gujarat
  
  
Direct Report Head – Design (Department Head)
  
  
**Main Focus & Challenges**
The focus of this position is to manage new product development projects (Compactors & Pavers) The position would have responsibility of leading the technical projects from feasibility to launch through structured approach. The role shall include high degree of collobration between cross functional team to ensure product upgrade from design, costing, quality, manufacturing and service standpoint of view. This role represents single point contact in domestic and global forums
  
  
**Core**
**Responsibilities**

* Form, manage and lead the cross-functional team(s) responsible for the complete and successful implementation of assigned projects
* Be responsible for the project(s) from start to finish, including timing, costs, scope of work, risk, communications and team project activities/deliverables
* Assign and follow-up on assigned actions in such a way as to fully understand the project status at all times
* For Industrialization focused projects, use the Ammann NPD Process to lead the project team through the gate requirements for a successful delivery.
* Promote manufacturing safety and efficiency through implementation of method/process changes, ergonomic application and safety awareness
* Establish and maintain project related budgets to show all opportunities and exceptions.
* Understand stakeholder requirements and distinguish between requirements and wants.
* Secure adequate internal and external resources to achieve project objectives
* Create and manage appropriate time plan(s) by defining tailored milestones and deliveries that complement and are in alignment with the project main time plan
* Ensure all communication and direction of plant related activities is coordinated through your project team and network
* Interact on a daily basis with other line organizations involved in the project
* Take active part of decision making with cross functional team
* Communicate effectively to ensure common goals are understood.
* Manage and Maintain all Project Status documentation and presentations
* Present Status Updates on a regular basis whether requested by managers, required by the process or by self-recognizing the need to do so
* Report project status, request for support, and make recommendations to the members of project(s) governing bodies

**Education And Experience**
Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Business, or similar
  
  
8+ years of progressive project management experience, leading medium to large scale projects
  
  
**Additional Requirements**

* Extensive knowledge of engineering concepts, manufacturing, the product, production standards and efficiency optimization tools
* Strong Leadership experience
* Demonstrated ability to successfully manage and coordinate cross functional teams
* Strong ability to successfully work with minimal direct instruction/supervision
* Excellent verbal and written skills
* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Talent for inspiring leadership
* Strong ability to prioritize
* High organizational ability and negotiation skills
* Technical background both about the product and the manufacturing processes
* A good understanding of automotive / heavy trucking / heavy engineering industry principles and/or business drivers
* Ability and willingness to learn new manufacturing systems
* Project Management Professional certification preferred but not mandatory

title: Ecommerce Assistant Manager
description:

Nadiad

5–8 Years

We are looking for a commercially driven
**Assistant Manager – E-commerce**
–
**Medfits**
to drive the growth of assigned categories across Shopify and marketplace channels. The role is responsible for end-to-end execution across merchandising, customer experience, digital growth, website optimization, and analytics to deliver category revenue growth and an exceptional customer experience.

The ideal candidate combines strong business acumen with hands-on experience, understands branding and consumer behaviour, and can translate insights into actions that improve business performance. * Own digital merchandising, product listings, collections, landing pages, promotions, and on-site merchandising.
* Partner with Digital Marketing teams to improve traffic quality, conversion, ROAS, and customer acquisition.
* Analyze category performance using Shopify Analytics, GA4, and marketplace dashboards, and translate insights into actionable growth initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to improve conversion rate, average order value (AOV), customer lifetime value (LTV), and repeat purchases.
* Coordinate with design, content, developers, agencies, and internal stakeholders to execute campaigns and website enhancements.
* Ensure brand consistency across all digital touchpoints while adapting the website experience to each category's positioning, target audience, and brand voice.
* Support CRM, retention, SEO, personalization, and customer engagement initiatives to drive sustainable growth.
* Monitor customer behaviour, market trends, and competitor activity to identify new growth opportunities and improve category performance.

**Desired Profile**

* 5–8 years of experience in E-commerce, preferably with consumer brands.
* Hands-on experience managing Shopify stores and scaling E-commerce businesses.
* Exposure to marketplaces such as Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Nykaa, or similar platforms.
* Strong understanding of digital merchandising, customer journeys, conversion rate optimization (CRO), and e-commerce best practices.
* Strong understanding of performance marketing across Meta, Google, and marketplace advertising, with the ability to interpret campaign performance and optimize business outcomes.
* Strong commercial and analytical acumen with the ability to convert data into business decisions.
* Good understanding of branding, consumer behaviour, category management, and marketing strategy.
* Strong visual sensibility with an eye for website aesthetics, product presentation, merchandising, and user experience.
* Ability to understand and adapt to different category strategies, brand voices, and customer segments.
* Experience collaborating with marketing, creative, technology, operations, and agency partners.
* Familiarity with GA4, Shopify Analytics, Search Console, Klaviyo, WebEngage, MoEngage, Shopify Flow, or similar D2C growth tools is preferred.
* Self-driven, adaptable, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced growth environment.

**Key Success Metrics**

* Category Revenue Growth
* Category Contribution & Profitability
* Shopify Revenue Growth
* Marketplace Revenue Growth
* Website Conversion Rate
* Average Order Value (AOV)
* Customer Lifetime Value (LTV)
* Customer Retention & Repeat Purchase Rate
* Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) & Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
* Website User Experience & Conversion Optimization
* Timely execution of category growth initiatives, product launches, and campaigns

If interested, you can share your CV on recruitment@mafatlals.com

title: Transformation & Manufacturing Performance Leader
description:
* As Transformation & Performance Leader, reporting directly to the Plant Head, you will be responsible for driving manufacturing transformation through digitalization, automation, process optimization, and global best-practice deployment. You will work closely with global stakeholders, manufacturing teams, digital technology teams, and functional leaders to identify and implement initiatives that improve productivity, cost competitiveness, quality, delivery, capacity, and overall plant performance.
* You will translate business challenges into actionable transformation initiatives, leveraging global expertise, digital technologies, data analytics, and automation solutions to enhance manufacturing processes and operational effectiveness.
* You will drive the transformation roadmap, ensure effective execution of initiatives, and track measurable business benefits while collaborating with existing Manufacturing, Lean, and Advanced Manufacturing teams. You will foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, accountability, Safety, Quality, and leadtime.
* Visualize and collaborate with leadership team to transform Sanand Facility into a modern, digital Smart Factory.
* Factory Performance Management
* Establish and lead a structured factory performance monitoring through Digital Tools and Dashboards and review process covering key operational and business KPIs.
* Use Real Time Data to Monitor performance trends, identify gaps against targets, highlight risks, and drive timely corrective actions with functional leaders.
* Partner with Production, Planning, Quality, Maintenance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing Engineering and Project teams to develop and implement targeted improvement initiatives that deliver measurable operational and financial benefits.
* Partner with Operational Excellence/ Lean teams to establish a culture of continuous improvement, ownership, and accountability by embedding standard work, visual management, performance tracking, and best practices across manufacturing operations.
* Provide the Plant Head with actionable insights on factory performance, key improvement priorities, and progress against business objectives.
* Link operational performance gaps to improvement initiatives and ensure sustained results.
* Transformation Portfolio & Business Impact
* Lead the identification, prioritization, and execution of major factory transformation projects aligned with business priorities.
* Develop and maintain a transformation roadmap with defined objectives, milestones, responsibilities, investments, and expected benefits.
* Ensure that each major transformation project addresses a specific factory performance gap and delivers measurable operational or financial improvements.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams, remove implementation barriers, manage project interdependencies, and ensure timely execution.
* Track and validate project benefits in collaboration with Finance and functional owners, ensuring sustainability of results.
* Report transformation progress, risks, realized benefits, and support requirements to the Plant Head.
* Collaborate with External Experts and Consultants in driving major transformation projects
* Manufacturing Transformation, Digitalization & Automation
* Identify opportunities to improve manufacturing processes, productivity, throughput, quality, lead time, and cost competitiveness.
* Drive digitalization and automation initiatives in collaboration with global digital, IT/OT, manufacturing, and Advanced Manufacturing teams.
* Leverage global technologies, best practices, data analytics, and Industry 4.0 solutions to address plant performance challenges.
* Develop business cases and prioritize initiatives based on operational impact, feasibility, investment, and return on investment.
* Work in partnership with existing Manufacturing, Lean, and Advanced Manufacturing leaders, leveraging their expertise and ensuring alignment with ongoing initiatives.

Facilitate the deployment and scaling of successful solutions across the plant and global manufacturing network.
  
  

* Global Stakeholder Management & Change Leadership
* Act as a key interface between the plant and global stakeholders for manufacturing transformation, digitalization, automation, and performance improvement.
* Identify and adapt global best practices and proven solutions to meet plant-specific business requirements.
* Drive cross-functional alignment, stakeholder engagement, and change management to ensure successful implementation and adoption.
* Promote a data-driven, performance-oriented culture focused on accountability, innovation, Safety, Quality, and Leadtime.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Factory performance against agreed operational and business targets.
* Delivery of the transformation roadmap and major project milestones.
* Validated financial benefits and sustained productivity improvements.
* Improvement in manufacturing cost, lead time, quality, throughput, and capacity utilization.
* Digitalization and automation project outcomes, adoption, and return on investment.
* Timely closure of performance gaps and corrective actions.

**Qualifications**
**Basic Qualifications (Requirements)**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Manufacturing, Automation, or a related engineering discipline. A master's degree or MBA in Operations Management or PG in Data Analytics is preferred.
* ~20+ years of experience in manufacturing, manufacturing engineering, operational transformation, digitalization, automation, or industrial operations, preferably in power-sector or heavy-engineering manufacturing.
* Proven experience in driving cross-functional improvement initiatives and delivering measurable business results.
* Good understanding of manufacturing processes, digital manufacturing technologies, industrial automation, and Industry 4.0 applications.
* Experience working with global teams, technology partners, and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Ability to develop business cases, evaluate investments, and measure financial and operational benefits.
* Strong project management, analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and change leadership skills.
* Familiarity with ERP/SAP, manufacturing data analytics, digital dashboards, and project management tools is preferred.
* A proactive, hands-on, and results-oriented mindset with the ability to convert business challenges into practical solutions.
* Willingness to travel to global manufacturing locations and technology partners as required.

**Reporting Structure**
**Reports to:**
Plant Head
  
  
**Key Interfaces:**
Global Manufacturing and Digital teams, Advanced Manufacturing, Manufacturing, Lean, Engineering, Quality, Maintenance, IT/OT, Finance, and Supply Chain.
  
  
Join us and work with global teams to support global customers ! At Arabelle Solutions, we have team members of more than 49 nationalities spread across 16 countries.
  
  
At Arabelle Solutions, we know diversity makes teams and business stronger.

title: Product Specialist - Weighing/ Packaging Machines
description:
Position: Assistant Manager- NPD ( New Product Development)

Location: Gandhinagar, Gujarat

Budget: Upto 15 LPA

**Role Summary**

The Assistant Manager – NPD acts as the starting point for new machine

development, translating market requirements into engineered solutions. The

role drives the complete product development cycle, from concept and design

calculations to prototyping, testing and production readiness, ensuring machines

are technically robust, reliable, manufacturable and cost-effective.

 Prepare 3D models, detailed part and assembly drawings with proper GD&T,

BOMs and technical specifications

 Apply DFM/DFA principles so the machine is easy to fabricate, assemble and

service.Use FEA or simulation where the design needs it.

 Plan and supervise the prototype build with the production and vendor

teams

 Define trial protocols, test against targets, analyse failures and close issues

and conduct DFMEA and design reviews at every stage gate.

 Support Channel partners to ensure achievement of annual plan & growth

targets.

 Release a production-ready documentation package and train the

manufacturing and service teams.

 Support the first installations and use field feedback to improve the design

 Run the NPD Process with Stage Gate review mechanism

Must Have:

 Proven NPD experience, with at least one machine or major module taken

from concept to production

 Strong command of engineering fundamentals and the ability to perform

design calculations independently

 Proficiency in SolidWorks, AutoCAD

 Sound knowledge of GD&T, materials, fabrication, machining, standard

mechanical components and pneumatics

Preference:

 Experience in weighing, packaging, filling, bagging, conveying or other special

purpose machines

 Exposure to FEA tools, DFMEA and stage-gate NPD processes

 Understanding of hygienic or dust-tight design for food, pharma or chemical

applications

title: Director, Information Technology
description:
**About Analog Devices**
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
  
  
**Director, Information Technology**
**Location:**
Gandhinagar, Gujarat, India
  
  
**Position Summary**
The
**Director, Information Technology**
will provide strategic and operational leadership for ADI's IT organization in India, driving technology strategy, business partnership, delivery excellence, and organizational development. The role will lead a portfolio of enterprise applications with a primary focus on supporting ADI's global Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Operations functions.
  
  
Working closely with business leaders, executive stakeholders, and global IT teams, the Director will lead strategic initiatives, application modernization, operational improvements, and AI-enabled digital transformation efforts that support business growth and operational excellence.
  
  
The Director will report to the Sr. Director, IT (India) and work closely with global IT and business leadership teams.

The successful candidate will be a people-first leader with exceptional leadership, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills. They will have a proven track record of building and developing high-performing teams across multiple locations, cultures, and time zones while effectively navigating both solid-line and matrixed reporting structures.
  
  
Through strong collaboration, influence, and relationship-building capabilities, this leader will foster alignment across business and IT organizations, drive accountability, and deliver results in a complex global environment.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a collaborative leader with strong business acumen, capable of delivering results through influence, developing future leaders, and fostering strong partnerships across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Operations, and IT.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic Leadership & Business Partnership**

* Partner with business and IT leaders to define and execute technology strategies supporting business priorities and enterprise IT initiatives.
* Drive portfolio planning, prioritization, governance, and execution of strategic programs.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to business leaders and identify opportunities for innovation, AI, automation, advanced analytics, and operational improvement.

* Drive adoption of AI-enabled solutions, intelligent automation, and data-driven decision-making capabilities.

**Organization & Talent Development**

* Lead and develop a high-performing organization of 50+ IT professionals across multiple locations.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, customer focus, and continuous improvement.
* Recruit, coach, mentor, and retain top talent while building a strong leadership pipeline and succession plans.
* Successfully lead through both direct and matrixed organizational structures, driving results through influence and collaboration.

**Operational Excellence & Governance**

* Establish performance metrics, operational dashboards, and governance mechanisms to drive delivery excellence.
* Champion continuous improvement through disciplined program, project, and portfolio management practices.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise standards, cybersecurity requirements, privacy policies, and risk management processes.
* Manage strategic vendor relationships, budgets, and stakeholder expectations.

**Qualifications**
**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related discipline.

**Experience**

* 15+ years of progressive IT leadership experience.
* Significant experience supporting Manufacturing and Supply Chain organizations within the semiconductor, high-tech manufacturing, or related industries.
* Preferred experience with enterprise applications such as SAP, Blue Yonder/JDA, and related business systems.
* Proven success leading business transformation, application modernization, and enterprise technology initiatives.
* Experience leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI, automation, and advanced analytics to deliver measurable business value and operational improvements.

* Exceptional leadership, communication, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills.
* Demonstrated success leading geographically distributed teams through direct leadership, matrix management, and stakeholder influence.
* Strong executive presence with the ability to influence senior leaders and build alignment across diverse organizations.
* Proven ability to develop talent, build organizational capability, and foster high-performance teams.
* Strategic thinker with a strong execution mindset and passion for continuous improvement.
* Strong understanding of how emerging technologies, including AI and automation, can be applied to solve business challenges and improve operational effectiveness.

title: NPD Manager
description:
**Role Overview:**

We are looking for an experienced
**NPD Manager**
to drive innovation and product development in the food and nutrition segment. The role involves managing the end-to-end New Product Development (NPD) lifecycle, from concept development and formulation to commercialization and product launch, with a focus on nutrition, taste, quality, food safety, and market demand.

The candidate will lead the development of products such as
**protein bars, protein powders, nutritional spreads, breakfast cereals, and other innovative food and nutrition products**
, ensuring regulatory compliance and commercial viability.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and launch innovative food and nutrition products, including
  **protein bars, protein powders, nutritional spreads, breakfast cereals, and other functional food products**
  .
* Manage the complete NPD lifecycle, from ideation and formulation to trials, scale-up, commercialization, and market launch.
* Ensure products meet nutritional requirements, taste expectations, quality standards, and consumer preferences.
* Ensure compliance with applicable FSSAI regulations, food safety standards, and product labelling requirements.
* Identify and evaluate new ingredients, functional ingredients, suppliers, and packaging materials.
* Conduct market research, competitor analysis, consumer trials, and sensory evaluations to improve product formulations.
* Collaborate with R&D, production, quality assurance, procurement, and marketing teams to ensure successful product launches.
* Optimize product formulations and manufacturing costs while maintaining product quality and nutritional value.
* Oversee product trials, shelf-life studies, stability testing, and manufacturing scale-up.
* Monitor project timelines, budgets, product performance, and commercialization milestones.
* Keep up to date with emerging trends in kids’ nutrition, functional foods, protein-based products, and health-focused FMCG categories.

title: Founders Office
description:

SurelyPlaced helps international candidates in the US (OPT, STEM OPT, CPT, H-1B and H-4 EAD) land the jobs they're qualified for. The Founder's Office is where our most important problems land first. This role is for someone who wants founder-level exposure early in their career, and who would rather own outcomes than tasks.

• ₹9 LPA fixed (₹75,000/month)

How to Apply

Apply directly through LinkedIn, or email your resume to hr@surelyplaced.com with the subject line "Founder's Office – [Your Name]". Bonus: include 3–4 lines on a project you fully owned and what it achieved.

* Straps

* Air vents
* Handles

* Weather resistance
* UV resistance
* Water repellency
* Breathability
* Strength
* Cost
* Customer expectations

* UV resistance
* Waterproofness

* Abrasion resistance
* Color fastness
* Weathering performance

* Outdoor covers
* Furniture covers
* Grill covers
* Equipment covers
* Automotive covers

* Design Team

* Manufacturing Team
* Quality Team
* Product Management Team

* Drive innovation projects from concept to production launch.

* Develop category-wise premium product positioning strategy.
* Launch improved construction standards for all key categories.

**Fabric Development**
Identify and validate lighter-weight fabric alternatives.
  
  
Develop fabric matrix for each cover category.
  
  
Deliver minimum 3–5 new fabric innovations.
  
  
**Innovation Pipeline**
Launch minimum 10 product improvement initiatives.
  
  
Reduce product weight while maintaining performance standards.
  
  
Improve customer satisfaction related to fit, appearance, and functionality.

Develop premium and value-engineered product tiers.
  
  
**Key Requirements**

* Technical Textiles
* Apparel Technology
* Product Engineering

**Experience**

* Technical textiles
* Outdoor products
* Protective covers
* Furniture covers
* Automotive covers
* Home furnishing products
* Product development

**Technical Skills**

* Fabric development and sourcing
* Sewing engineering
* Pattern development
* Technical textiles
* Product testing
* Product innovation
* Vendor development
